description.message: Sends your YouTube sign-in cookies to your own Homescribe server so it can download YouTube links.

pairHint.message: In Homescribe open Settings → YouTube → Connect the extension, then enter the address and the code shown there.

pairQuestion.message: Send your YouTube cookies to this Homescribe server?

pairDone.message: Connected. The cookies are sent; you can close this tab.

errorNoCookies.message: No YouTube cookies in this browser. Sign in at youtube.com first.

errorUnpaired.message: The server no longer knows this browser. Connect again.

errorCode.message: The code is wrong or expired. Make a new one in Homescribe.

errorPermission.message: Access to the server was not allowed.

errorAddress.message: Enter the server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080

errorLink.message: This link is incomplete. Open it again from Homescribe's settings.

remoteWarning.message: This address is not on your local network. Continue only if it is your own Homescribe server: whoever runs it gets access to your YouTube account.
